_about: Tuning set for api/safety.py crisis detection. Fields: text; label crisis|concern|safe (concern = ambiguous passive phrasing that must get at least the concern check-in; crisis also passes); severity imminent (plan, method or timeline) | ideation; clear = unambiguous suicidal or self-harm intent (target: zero misses); lang en|tl|taglish. The held-out set (heldout.json) was written at the same time, before the detector changed, and is not used for tuning.
